name: kino-plugin-video-gram
description: Kino plugin Video-Gram: your Telegram videos in Kino over MTProto (a bot, or your own account read only).

scripts.validate: npm run build && node sdk/validate.mjs . --repo kinotvapp/kino-plugin-video-gram
scripts.sign: npm run build && node sdk/seal.mjs --sign --repo kinotvapp/kino-plugin-video-gram --key ~/.config/kino/kino-author-key.pem
